mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_assignment a JOIN sys_user au ON au.user_id = a.user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = au.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) WHERE a.task_id = t.id) AS assignedCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM task_submission s WHERE s.task_id = t.id) AS submittedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submission s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s.status = 'SUBMITTED') AS pendingReviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_post tp WHERE tp.task_id = t.id AND tp.deleted_by IS NULL) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_attachment ta WHERE ta.task_id = t.id AND ta.deleted = 0) AS attachmentCount
mapper.select:
SELECT t.*, p.position_name AS positionName, pu.nick_name AS publisherName, ru.nick_name AS reviewerName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u.nick_name ORDER BY u.user_id) FROM task_target_user tt JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tt.user_id WHERE tt.task_id = t.id) AS targetNames,
, (SELECT a2.status FROM task_assignment a2 WHERE a2.task_id = t.id AND a2.user_id = #{userId}) AS assignStatus
FROM learning_task t LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = t.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.user_id = t.publisher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = t.reviewer_id WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND ( t.position_id IN ( SELECT dp.position_id FROM dept_position dp WHERE dp.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} AND dp.status = 1) OR (t.position_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user pdu WHERE pdu.user_id = t.publisher_id AND pdu.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId})) )
AND t.position_id = #{positionId}
AND t.status = #{status}
AND t.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_assignment a3 WHERE a3.task_id = t.id AND a3.user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.*, p.position_name AS positionName, pu.nick_name AS publisherName, pu.dept_id AS publisherDeptId, ru.nick_name AS reviewerName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u.nick_name ORDER BY u.user_id) FROM task_target_user tt JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tt.user_id WHERE tt.task_id = t.id) AS targetNames, FROM learning_task t LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = t.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.user_id = t.publisher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = t.reviewer_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.task_name AS taskName, t.course_id AS courseId, t.position_id AS positionId, t.target, t.description, t.theory_hours AS theoryHours, t.practice_hours AS practiceHours, t.start_time AS startTime, t.deadline, t.need_assignment AS needAssignment, t.allow_resubmit AS allowResubmit, t.discussion_enabled AS discussionEnabled, t.status, t.create_time AS createTime, p.position_name AS positionName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_post tp WHERE tp.task_id = t.id AND tp.deleted_by IS NULL) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_attachment ta WHERE ta.task_id = t.id AND ta.deleted = 0) AS attachmentCount, a.id AS assignmentId, a.status AS assignStatus, s.status AS submissionStatus, s.review_status AS reviewStatus, s.review_comment AS reviewComment, s.submit_time AS submitTime, s.file_url AS fileUrl, s.file_name AS fileName FROM task_assignment a JOIN learning_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = t.position_id LEFT JOIN task_submission s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.version = (SELECT MAX(x.version) FROM task_submission x WHERE x.assignment_id = a.id) WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (t.deadline IS NULL), t.deadline ASC, t.id DESC

SELECT u.user_id FROM sys_user u JOIN dept_position dp ON dp.position_id = u.position_id AND dp.status = 1 WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.position_id = #{positionId} AND u.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE', 'PENDING_PROMOTE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id FROM sys_user u JOIN dept_position dp ON dp.position_id = u.position_id AND dp.status = 1 WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE', 'PENDING_PROMOTE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.user_id AS userId, a.status AS assignStatus, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName, s.id AS submissionId, s.status AS submissionStatus, s.review_status AS reviewStatus, s.review_comment AS reviewComment, s.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, s.review_time AS reviewTime, ru.nick_name AS reviewerName, s.submit_time AS submitTime, s.version AS version, s.content AS content, s.file_url AS fileUrl, s.file_name AS fileName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submission x WHERE x.assignment_id = a.id) AS submissionCount FROM task_assignment a JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN task_submission s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.version = (SELECT MAX(x.version) FROM task_submission x WHERE x.assignment_id = a.id) LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = s.reviewer_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY (s.id IS NULL) DESC, u.user_id

SELECT s.id AS submissionId, s.assignment_id AS assignmentId, s.task_id AS taskId, s.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS nickName, s.version AS version, s.content AS content, s.file_url AS fileUrl, s.file_name AS fileName, s.submit_time AS submitTime, s.status AS submissionStatus, s.review_status AS reviewStatus, s.review_comment AS reviewComment, s.review_time AS reviewTime, ru.nick_name AS reviewerName FROM task_submission s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = s.reviewer_id WHERE s.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY s.version DESC

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS userName, t.id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, t.deadline AS deadline, t.reviewer_id AS reviewerId FROM task_assignment a JOIN learning_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) WHERE a.status <> 'DONE' AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline < NOW()

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.user_id AS userId, t.id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, t.deadline AS deadline, t.reviewer_id AS reviewerId FROM task_assignment a JOIN learning_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) WHERE a.status <> 'DONE' AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline >= NOW() AND t.deadline <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id)
